name: Supply & demand
summary: Price and volume in a market move with shifts in demand (customers, substitutes, income, trends) and supply (capacity, input costs, entrants). Use it to explain or forecast market prices.
opening_line: A price change in a commodity-like market is usually a shift in supply or demand, so I'd look at what changed on each side and how capacity will respond.
when_to_use: Commodity or market price changes (oil, crops, shipping rates)
Forecasting market prices or capacity additions
when_not_to_use: Differentiated products where the firm sets its own price: use pricing

buckets.name: Shift
questions: Did the demand curve or the supply curve move?
data_to_ask: Volumes, capacity, input prices over time

industry_adaptations.note: OPEC supply decisions, shale breakeven costs, demand from transport and industry.
Weather and yields drive supply; stock-to-use ratio.

common_mistakes: Not distinguishing short-run vs long-run supply response
